def transform(grid):
    # The output is the inside (one-cell inset) of the largest solid colored rectangle.
    colors={2,3,4,5,8}
    best=None
    for color in colors:
        cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==color]
        if not cells: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        area=len(cells)
        if best is None or area>best[0]: best=(area,color,r0,r1,c0,c1)
    _,color,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    h=r1-r0-1; w=c1-c0-1
    return [[color]*w for _ in range(h)]
PY
